messages:
Ravi (partnerships): Heads-up: CobaltSilicon sent a countersigned NDA for their XPR modules. They want a 1-week preview to run benchmarks + marketplace checks. Who's up?
Nora (eng-ml): I'm in for benchmarks. Will need 300 eval prompts, latency/throughput slices, and int8 vs fp16 quality checks.
Sam (infra): We'll treat the lab as segmented. No egress except cobalt-telemetry.cobalt.io. Jump host with session recording only.
Tess (platform): Can we get 2 units to our SEA lab? Also need console creds and allowed image list.
Ravi (partnerships): Shipping 2 units to SEA lab, ETA Tue. Images: xpr-fp16, xpr-int8; flashing our runtime allowed but keep vendor bootloader.
legal-bot: Note: telemetry allowed for performance; publishing any example outputs needs legal sign-off. External engineer access requires an addendum.
Nora (eng-ml): Bench plan (short): 1) p50/p95 for 256/1024 tokens 2) batch 1/8/32 throughput 3) quantized quality delta on eval-300. Will publish aggregated deltas only.
Sam (infra): Firewall snippet for jump host:
```
allow redwood-lab -> xpr-units:22,443
egress deny all except telemetry.cobalt.io:443
```
Also enable disk encryption and auditd.
Tess (platform): Proposed env for runs: REDWOOD_RUN=cobalt-xpr-preview-2026 RW_BATCH=8 RW_PREFILL=2 RW_SEED=7. Use same across all runs.
Ravi (partnerships): Action items: Sam-provision lab (Tue 09:00), Tess-install images + smoke (Tue EOD), Nora-bench suite + eval (Wed EOD), Ravi-coordinate addendum + comms.
marketing-bot: Reminder: If Cobalt requests embargoed numbers, attach draft copy in /marketing/drafts for review.
Ravi (partnerships): Quick check-in Friday 10:00 PT after smoke runs. Ping #eng-oncall for failures. Thanks everyone.
